vector_memory.semantic_summary: OpenAIAPIModel serves as a generalized, OpenAI-compatible service layer for interacting with various LLM providers, abstracting API nuances. Its core function is to enforce a 'Sentinel Protocol' by flattening native tool calls into pure text markers for consistent interception. It manages configuration, integrates robust retry logic, and tracks telemetry metrics during chat completions or streaming responses.
